analysis.scope_and_question: The review focuses on mRNA-Lipid Nanoparticle (mRNA-LNP) vaccines for infectious diseases, with a specific emphasis on the Mpox virus. The central question is how these vaccines function mechanistically and their translational progress in combating Mpox and related diseases.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is a preprint published in 2026, which provides a comprehensive overview of mRNA-LNP vaccine development. It includes evidence from mouse models and human lymph node sampling, with attention to species differences in innate cytokine control. The review does not explicitly report on meta-analysis or pooled estimates but synthesizes findings from various studies.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review concludes that mRNA-LNP vaccines have transitioned from a platform without a licensed product to one that is widely used for diseases like Mpox. It highlights the importance of understanding the molecular mechanisms of RNA translation and lipid nanoparticle behavior for vaccine development.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: There are controversies regarding the molecular identity of the lipid sensor and the difficulty of separating immunogenicity from reactogenicity. Additionally, the review notes the absence of a quantitative description of endosomal escape and challenges in designing antigens for pathogens that do not tolerate a single fixed immunogen.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review suggests that future research should focus on identifying the molecular identity of the lipid sensor, improving the separation of immunogenicity from reactogenicity, quantifying endosomal escape, and developing antigens for pathogens that do not tolerate a single fixed immunogen.

analysis.summary_en: This review explores the development and mechanisms of mRNA-Lipid Nanoparticle (mRNA-LNP) vaccines for infectious diseases, with a focus on the Mpox virus. It outlines the transition of mRNA-LNP vaccines from an unlicensed platform to a significant contributor in combating Mpox and other diseases. The review emphasizes the need to understand RNA translation and lipid nanoparticle behavior for effective vaccine design. It highlights controversies in identifying the lipid sensor, separating immunogenicity from reactogenicity, and quantifying endosomal escape. The implications for future research include addressing these gaps and improving antigen design for pathogens with complex immunogenic profiles.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 该综述重点关注用于感染性疾病的 mRNA-脂质纳米颗粒 (mRNA-LNP) 疫苗,特别重点关注 猴痘病毒。核心问题是这些 疫苗 如何发挥作用,以及它们在对抗 猴痘 和相关疾病方面的转化进展。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该综述是 2026 年发表的预印本,全面概述了 mRNA-LNP 疫苗 的开发。它包括来自小鼠模型和人类淋巴结采样的证据,并关注先天细胞因子控制的物种差异。该综述没有明确报告荟萃分析或汇总估计,而是综合了各种研究的结果。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 审查得出的结论是,mRNA-LNP 疫苗 已经从一个没有许可产品的平台转变为广泛用于治疗 猴痘 等疾病的平台。它强调了了解 RNA 翻译的分子机制和脂质纳米颗粒行为对于 疫苗 开发的重要性。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 关于脂质传感器的分子特性以及区分免疫原性和反应原性的难度存在争议。此外,该评论指出,缺乏对内体逃逸的定量描述,以及为不耐受单一固定免疫原的病原体设计抗原时面临的挑战。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 该综述表明,未来的研究应侧重于识别脂质传感器的分子身份,改善免疫原性与反应原性的分离,量化内体逃逸,以及开发不耐受单一固定免疫原的病原体的抗原。

abstract_zh: 在首次获得紧急使用授权六年后,mRNA-脂质纳米颗粒(mRNA-LNP)疫苗已经从一个没有许可产品的平台转变为供应全球大部分COVID-19和呼吸道合胞病毒(RSV)疫苗剂量的平台,并已完成针对季节性流感的3期试验。它们的性能取决于在个体细胞类型、受体和分子相互作用水平上以异常速度解决的机制,并且在此过程中必须修改一些教科书的假设。本次审查遵循 疫苗 从配方瓶到生发中心的整个过程。我们首先描述了如何设计 RNA 以实现有效翻译并部分逃离胞质和内体 RNA 传感器,以及为什么 N1-甲基假尿苷既不是免疫沉默也不是翻译中性。然后,我们研究可电离脂质、辅助磷脂、胆固醇和 PEG-脂质如何决定颗粒行为、细胞摄取和内体释放,以及脂质和 RNA 成分如何充当可分离的佐剂信号。比较了来自小鼠模型和人类淋巴结采样的证据,并注意先天细胞因子控制方面的巨大物种差异,这限制了从小鼠到人类的外推。临床部分总结了 COVID-19、RSV 和流感 疫苗 的疗效和免疫原性数据,以及针对巨细胞病毒、猴痘、HIV、疟疾、尼帕病毒和艰难梭菌的候选药物的临床前和早期临床状态。安全数据以绝对术语而不是单独作为信号来讨论。我们以目前阻碍合理改进的问题作为结束语:脂质传感器的分子特性、将免疫原性与反应原性分开的困难、缺乏内体逃逸的定量描述以及不耐受单一固定免疫原的病原体的抗原设计。

title: Tools without trust: public health diplomacy and the 2026 Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in East Africa
abstract: Public health emergencies test relationships as much as laboratories. On 15 May 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) confirmed an outbreak of Bundibugyo virus in Mongbwalu, Ituri Province, and the World Health Organization declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) on 17 May (1,2). As of 2 September 2026, the DRC epidemic had reached 6,342 confirmed cases and 3,072 confirmed deaths (2). Uganda, by contrast, had successfully interrupted transmission, and both the World Health Organization and Uganda's Ministry of Health subsequently declared the outbreak over. Nevertheless, Uganda continued to face travel-related restrictions, prompting Africa CDC Director-General Jean Kaseya to call for their removal at the July 2026 African Union health summit (3). analysis.methods: The editorial uses a qualitative analysis of public health diplomacy, drawing on the DRC and Uganda's experiences with the Bundibugyo virus outbreak. abstract_zh: 突发公共卫生事件对人际关系的考验不亚于对实验室的考验。2026 年 5 月 15 日,刚果民主共和国 (DRC) 在伊图里省蒙布瓦卢确认了本迪布焦病毒 暴发,世界卫生组织于 5 月 17 日宣布国际关注的突发公共卫生事件 (PHEIC) (1,2)。截至 2026 年 9 月 2 日,刚果民主共和国疫情已达 6,342 例确诊病例和 3,072 例死亡病例 (2)。相比之下,乌干达成功中断了传播,世界卫生组织和乌干达卫生部随后宣布暴发结束。尽管如此,乌干达继续面临与旅行相关的限制,促使非洲疾病预防控制中心总干事让·卡塞亚 (Jean Kaseya) 在 2026 年 7 月的非洲联盟卫生峰会上呼吁取消这些限制 (3)。他的论点是,各国不应因透明报告而受到惩罚,这正是这篇社论所要解决的问题。我们狭隘地使用公共卫生外交:邻国及其区域集团之间的长期法律和制度安排,使跨境应对措施能够在政治压力下运作。所面临的信任是卫生部的信心,即透明的报告将带来区域支持而不是单方面惩罚。《国际卫生条例》(IHR)(2005)对快速通报的期望并不总是与对其经济和政治后果的保护相匹配。这种区域性的公共卫生外交必须作为和平时期的基础设施来建设,而不是在紧急情况下临时搭建。这种差距是合法的,其后果远远超出了数据治理的范围。跨境 监测 学术区分了此类响应所依赖的四个互操作性维度:技术、语义、组织和法律 (4)。在本迪布焦回应中,东通知。非洲疾病预防控制中心 2024 年 8 月的 猴痘 声明显示,区域激励结构 65 可以奖励早期通知 (5)。卡塞亚向加纳发出的呼吁阐明了政治必要性。如果遵守国际报告义务的国家继续承担不成比例的 67 成本,全球 暴发 通报系统的可信度可能会受到削弱。

title: Editorial: The role and impact of field epidemiology training programs (FETPs) around the globe
abstract: • Contributed to global collaboration, with graduates deployed internationally to support cross-border outbreak responses and humanitarian emergencies.The impact of FETPs extends beyond technical skills as they foster trust in public health systems, empower countries to meet International Health Regulations (IHR) requirements, and reduce reliance on external expertise by cultivating local capacity 7 . Thus, FETPs transform health security from a reactive posture into a proactive, resilient system.The collection of studies presented here offers a panoramic view of FETPs across diverse regions from Papua New Guinea to Tunisia, Canada, Sudan, and the Eastern Mediterranean highlighting both their transformative impact and persistent challenges.The evaluation of Papua The regional workshop on institutionalization in the Eastern Mediterranean [[Study Link]] underscores the importance of embedding FETPs within national strategies. Participants from nine countries identified funding constraints and undefined career tracks as major barriers.Complementing this, the survey of 129 mentors across nine EMR countries [[Study Link]] revealed challenges in time management and resource adequacy, alongside strong demand for training in mentoring techniques and leadership.The global experience of FETPs, as showcased in this collection of papers entitled "The Role and Impact of Field Epidemiology Training Programs (FETPs) Around the Globe," highlights their remarkable achievements in strengthening public health systems and building epidemiological capacity, while also revealing persistent challenges that require sustained attention and collective action. Programs in resource-constrained settings like Papua New Guinea showcase how intentional design can yield outsized impact. Tunisia and the MENA region highlight the dangers of episodic gains without institutional embedding. Canada illustrates the evolution of mature programs, while Sudan's Mpox response underscores the real-time value of FETP competencies. Regional surveys reveal widespread application of skills but also unmet needs in continuing education and mentorship.As public health threats become increasingly complex and interconnected, the imperative is clear: FETPs must be recognized as permanent and integral pillars of national and global health systems. This requires sustained investment in their expansion, strengthening, longterm sustainability, and institutionalization to ensure a skilled epidemiological workforce capable of anticipating, detecting, and responding effectively to current and emerging public health threats.Investment in mentorship, career pathways, and ongoing professional development will ensure that graduates not only respond to crises but also shape resilient, proactive systems. The collective evidence presented here makes a compelling case: strengthening and sustaining FETPs is essential for advancing global health security and preparing for the epidemics of tomorrow.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to highlight the role and impact of field epidemiology training programs (FETPs) in enhancing global health security, particularly in the context of mpox outbreaks and public health threats. The need for such programs arises from the increasing complexity and interconnectedness of health challenges, necessitating a proactive and resilient approach.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study is an editorial that reviews a collection of papers on FETPs across various regions, including Papua New Guinea, Tunisia, Canada, Sudan, and the Eastern Mediterranean. It evaluates the global experience of FETPs and their contributions to strengthening public health systems and building epidemiological capacity.
analysis.methods: The editorial synthesizes findings from multiple studies, including regional workshops and surveys of mentors across nine countries. It examines the challenges and achievements of FETPs in different settings, focusing on their design, implementation, and institutional embedding.
analysis.main_results: Participants from nine countries identified funding constraints and undefined career tracks as major barriers. The survey of 129 mentors across nine EMR countries revealed challenges in time management and resource adequacy, alongside strong demand for training in mentoring techniques and leadership.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret that FETPs have demonstrated significant achievements in strengthening public health systems and building epidemiological capacity, but they also highlight persistent challenges that require sustained attention and collective action. This analysis underscores the need for institutional embedding and long-term support.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings inform the importance of investing in FETPs to ensure a skilled epidemiological workforce capable of anticipating, detecting, and responding effectively to current and emerging public health threats, particularly in the context of mpox and other complex outbreaks.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is based on abstract-only evidence, which may limit the depth of analysis. However, the collection of studies provides a broad overview of FETPs across diverse regions, supporting a moderate confidence assessment in the conclusions drawn.

analysis.summary_en: This editorial examines the role and impact of field epidemiology training programs (FETPs) in enhancing global health security, particularly in the context of mpox outbreaks. It highlights how FETPs contribute to strengthening public health systems and building epidemiological capacity, while also identifying persistent challenges such as funding constraints and undefined career tracks. The study emphasizes the need for sustained investment in FETPs to ensure their long-term sustainability and institutionalization. It also underscores the importance of mentorship and continuing education in maintaining a skilled workforce. The findings suggest that FETPs are essential for addressing complex and interconnected public health threats, but their effectiveness depends on overcoming institutional and resource barriers. The evidence is based on abstract-only data, which limits the depth of analysis but still supports a moderate confidence in the conclusions.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在强调现场 流行病学 培训计划 (FETP) 在增强全球卫生安全方面的作用和影响,特别是在 猴痘 暴发 和公共卫生威胁的背景下。由于健康挑战日益复杂和相互关联,因此需要采取此类计划,因此需要采取积极主动和有弹性的方法。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究是一篇社论,回顾了巴布亚新几内亚、突尼斯、加拿大、苏丹和东地中海等不同地区有关 FETP 的论文集。它评估了 FETP 的全球经验及其对加强公共卫生系统和建设流行病学能力的贡献。
elements_zh.methods: 该社论综合了多项研究的结果,包括区域研讨会和对九个国家导师的调查。它研究了 FETP 在不同环境中的挑战和成就,重点关注其设计、实施和制度嵌入。
elements_zh.main_results: 来自九个国家的参与者认为资金限制和不明确的职业轨迹是主要障碍。对 9 个 EMR 国家的 129 名导师进行的调查揭示了时间管理和资源充足性方面的挑战,以及对指导技术和领导力培训的强烈需求。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,FETP 在加强公共卫生系统和建设流行病学能力方面取得了重大成就,但它们也强调了需要持续关注和集体行动的持续挑战。该分析强调了机构嵌入和长期支持的必要性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明了投资 FETP 的重要性,以确保熟练的流行病学工作人员能够有效地预测、检测和应对当前和新出现的公共卫生威胁,特别是在 猴痘 和其他复杂的 暴发 的背景下。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅基于抽象证据,这可能会限制分析的深度。然而,收集的研究提供了不同地区 FETP 的广泛概述,支持对得出的结论进行适度的置信度评估。

abstract_zh: • 为全球合作做出了贡献,毕业生在全球范围内部署,以支持跨境 暴发 应对和人道主义紧急情况。FETP 的影响超出了技术技能范围,因为它们增强了对公共卫生系统的信任,使各国能够满足国际卫生条例 (IHR) 的要求,并通过培养当地能力减少对外部专业知识的依赖 7。因此,FETP 将卫生安全从被动的姿态转变为主动、有弹性的系统。这里介绍的研究集合提供了从巴布亚新几内亚到突尼斯、加拿大、苏丹和东地中海等不同地区的 FETP 全景,强调了它们的变革性影响和持续的挑战。巴布亚东地中海制度化区域研讨会 [[研究链接]] 的评估强调了将 FETP 纳入国家战略的重要性。来自 9 个国家的参与者将资金限制和未定义的职业轨迹视为主要障碍。除此之外,对 9 个 EMR 国家的 129 名导师进行的调查[[研究链接]]揭示了时间管理和资源充足性方面的挑战,以及对指导技术和领导力培训的强烈需求。题为“全球现场 流行病学 培训计划 (FETP) 的作用和影响”的论文集展示了 FETP 的全球经验,强调了他们的经验在加强公共卫生系统和建设流行病学能力方面取得了显著成就,同时也揭示了需要持续关注和集体行动的持续挑战。巴布亚新几内亚等资源有限地区的项目展示了有意的设计如何产生巨大的影响。突尼斯和中东和北非地区强调了没有制度嵌入的间歇性收益的危险。加拿大展示了成熟项目的 进化,而苏丹的 猴痘 响应则强调了 FETP 能力的实时价值。区域调查揭示了技能的广泛应用,但在继续教育和指导方面也存在未满足的需求。随着公共卫生威胁变得越来越复杂和相互关联,当务之急是明确的:必须将 FETP 视为国家和全球卫生系统永久且不可或缺的支柱。这需要对其扩展、加强、长期可持续性和制度化进行持续投资,以确保拥有一支熟练的流行病学队伍,能够有效预测、发现和应对当前和新出现的公共卫生威胁。对指导、职业道路和持续专业发展的投资将确保毕业生不仅能够应对危机,而且能够塑造有弹性、主动的系统。这里提供的集体证据令人信服:加强和维持 FETP 对于推进全球卫生安全和应对未来流行病至关重要。

title: A Koopman-PINN Framework for Epidemic Models: Parameter Inference and Forecasting
abstract: We propose a Koopman-enhanced physics-informed neural network (K-PINN) framework for parameter inference and forecasting in nonlinear epidemic models. This method combines Koopman operator theory and physics-informed learning. It maps epidemic states into a latent observable space where the dynamics evolve approximately linearly while satisfying the governing epidemic equations through automatic differentiation. This integration improves interpretability, parameter identifiability, and long-term predictive stability. We apply the proposed framework to a normalized SEIRSD epidemic model and evaluate it using synthetic monkeypox (Mpox) data and real-world datasets from Germany, Morocco, and Sweden for the SARS-CoV-2 virus. Synthetic trajectories are generated using a structure-preserving, nonstandard finite difference scheme to ensure reliable training data. Numerical results demonstrate that K-PINN achieves more accurate parameter estimation, trajectory reconstruction, and long-term forecasting than classical PINNs and Koopman-EDMD approaches. These results suggest that K-PINN is an effective machine learning framework for epidemic modeling that can be extended to more complex systems.
journal: Numerical Mathematics Theory Methods and Applications

abstract: Clade II mpox frequently presents as localised anogenital disease and may closely resemble herpes simplex virus (HSV) infection. We report PCR confirmed clade II mpox in a previously healthy man following sexual exposure in Spain. On return to the UK, he presented to a sexual health service with rectal pain. Sexually transmitted infection (STI) screening, including HSV PCR, HIV and syphilis serology, was performed and all the results were negative. He developed anogenital lesion a day later and attended urgent care where he was clinically diagnosed with primary HSV and commenced on oral aciclovir without lesion sampling. Lesions progressed rapidly despite therapy. On relocation days later, he presented to Accident and Emergency with acute urinary retention. Referral to local Genitourinary Medicine service resulted in repeat STI plus other testing. All the results were negative except mpox clade II PCR. This case highlights the importance of epidemiological reasoning, comprehensive STI assessment, structured evaluation and system-level strategies to mitigate diagnostic anchoring.

full_text:
Abstract A data-driven SEIR model is proposed to investigate the transmission dynamics of monkeypox. The susceptible population is divided into aware and unaware classes to capture behavioral changes that affect disease spread, while a saturated treatment function captures healthcare capacity limitations during outbreaks. Model parameters are estimated using demographic and epidemiological data, along with least-squares curve fitting based on reported monkeypox cases in the USA. The basic reproduction number \(R_0\) is derived using the next-generation matrix approach, and the local stability of disease-free and endemic equilibria is analyzed. Bifurcation analysis reveals that variations in awareness and treatment capacity can significantly alter disease dynamics and induce qualitative transitions in system behavior. Sensitivity analysis identifies the key parameters that influence \(R_0\) and the spread of infection. Furthermore, optimal control strategies involving vaccination and isolation are implemented to minimize infection prevalence and intervention costs. Numerical simulations demonstrate that increased awareness and timely interventions effectively reduce disease burden and improve outbreak control. Similar content being viewed by others Data Availability All of the authors state that all data generated or analyzed during this study are included in this article. The manuscript has associated data in a data repository. full_text_sections.full_text: Abstract A data-driven SEIR model is proposed to investigate the transmission dynamics of monkeypox. The susceptible population is divided into aware and unaware classes to capture behavioral changes that affect disease spread, while a saturated treatment function captures healthcare capacity limitations during outbreaks. Model parameters are estimated using demographic and epidemiological data, along with least-squares curve fitting based on reported monkeypox cases in the USA. The basic reproduction number \(R_0\) is derived using the next-generation matrix approach, and the local stability of disease-free and endemic equilibria is analyzed. Bifurcation analysis reveals that variations in awareness and treatment capacity can significantly alter disease dynamics and induce qualitative transitions in system behavior. Sensitivity analysis identifies the key parameters that influence \(R_0\) and the spread of infection. Furthermore, optimal control strategies involving vaccination and isolation are implemented to minimize infection prevalence and intervention costs. Numerical simulations demonstrate that increased awareness and timely interventions effectively reduce disease burden and improve outbreak control. The manuscript has associated data in a data repository. title_original: A Data-Driven Study of the Dynamical Analysis and Optimal Control of an SEIR Mpox Model with Public Awareness and Healthcare Capacity

analysis.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to investigate the transmission dynamics of monkeypox using a data-driven SEIR model incorporating public awareness and healthcare capacity, addressing the need for understanding disease spread and control strategies during outbreaks.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A data-driven SEIR model was developed to simulate monkeypox transmission dynamics, with parameters estimated using demographic and epidemiological data from the USA. The model integrates public awareness and healthcare capacity limitations to reflect real-world conditions during outbreaks.
analysis.methods: Model parameters were estimated using demographic and epidemiological data, along with least-squares curve fitting based on reported monkeypox cases in the USA. Sensitivity analysis was conducted to identify key parameters influencing the basic reproduction number $R_0$ and the spread of infection.
analysis.main_results: Numerical simulations demonstrated that increased public awareness and timely interventions effectively reduce disease burden and improve outbreak control. The basic reproduction number $R_0$ was derived using the next-generation matrix approach, and the local stability of disease-free and endemic equilibria was analyzed.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted that variations in awareness and treatment capacity can significantly alter disease dynamics and induce qualitative transitions in system behavior, highlighting the novelty of integrating these factors into the model for outbreak prediction and control.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings can inform public health strategies by emphasizing the importance of public awareness campaigns and optimizing healthcare capacity to effectively manage and control monkeypox outbreaks.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its reliance on reported monkeypox cases in the USA, which may not fully represent global dynamics. The evidence is moderate as it is based on model simulations and curve fitting, with no direct clinical or field data provided.

analysis.summary_en: This study presents a data-driven SEIR model to analyze the transmission dynamics of monkeypox, incorporating public awareness and healthcare capacity limitations. The model uses demographic and epidemiological data from the USA, along with least-squares curve fitting, to estimate parameters and assess disease spread. Results show that increased awareness and timely interventions significantly reduce disease burden and improve outbreak control. The authors interpret that variations in awareness and treatment capacity can alter disease dynamics and induce qualitative transitions in system behavior, offering novel insights into outbreak management. These findings have implications for public health strategies, emphasizing the role of awareness campaigns and healthcare optimization. However, the study's reliance on USA data and model-based results limits the confidence in its generalizability, resulting in moderate evidence strength.

title: Geospatial analysis and predictive modelling of mpox transmission hotspots: a case study of Ogun State, Nigeria
abstract: Mpox is a recurring public health threat in Nigeria and was re-declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern in August 2024. Nigeria's Integrated Disease Surveillance and Response system operates at the Local Government Area (LGA) level, yet published mpox risk models resolve risk only at state level, forcing uniform deployment across heterogeneous LGAs. This study developed and evaluated an LGA-resolution geospatial risk layer for the 20 LGAs of Ogun State and integrated it, as a proof of concept, into a live surveillance platform. State-level records of 40 laboratory-confirmed cases (NCDC, 2022) and 151 suspected cases (Ogun State Ministry of Health, 2022–2024), 191 in total, were spatially disaggregated into 189 pseudo-presence points and modelled with an ensemble of maximum entropy, random forest, and extreme gradient boosting over 100 bootstrap replicates. Discrimination was good under random hold-out (AUC 0.77; Boyce index 0.99) but fell under spatially blocked cross-validation (AUC 0.57), indicating that the layer is suited to coarse triage between tiers rather than within-tier ranking. Seven LGAs were classified high risk along a central corridor anchored on Abeokuta South and the Ijebu–Remo axis, six medium, and seven low. The tiered layer was exported as GeoJSON with tier-specific action packages and integrated into the IDS-Master platform as a proof-of-concept pathway from spatial epidemiology to routine public health surveillance. Because the 189 points were disaggregated from aggregate counts rather than individually geolocated, the tiers should be read as a spatial prior for triage rather than as confirmed case locations.

The researchers developed a geospatial risk layer for the 20 LGAs of Ogun State, integrating it into a live surveillance platform as a proof of concept. They used an ensemble of machine learning models to analyze 191 cases, spatially disaggregated into 189 pseudo-presence points. The model showed good discrimination under random hold-out but lower performance under spatially blocked cross-validation, suggesting it is suitable for tiered triage rather than within-tier ranking. elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 猴痘 是尼日利亚反复出现的公共卫生威胁,并于 2024 年 8 月被重新宣布为国际关注的突发公共卫生事件。尼日利亚的综合疾病 猴痘 和响应系统在地方政府地区 (LGA) 层面运行,但发布的 猴痘 风险模型仅在州层面解决风险,迫使异构地方政府地区进行统一部署。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究开发并评估了奥贡州 20 个 LGA 的 LGA 分辨率地理空间风险层,并将其作为概念验证集成到实时 监测 平台中。40 例实验室确诊病例(NCDC,2022 年)和 151 例疑似病例(奥贡州卫生部,2022 年至 2024 年)的州级记录,总共 191 例,在空间上分解为 189 个伪存在点,并使用最大熵、随机森林和极端梯度提升的集合建模,超过 100 个引导重复。
elements_zh.methods: 由于 189 个点是从总计数中分解出来的,而不是单独进行地理定位的,因此这些层应被解读为分诊的空间先验,而不是已确认的病例位置。
elements_zh.main_results: 在随机保留下(AUC 0.77;博伊斯指数 0.99),区分度良好,但在空间阻塞交叉验证(AUC 0.57)下,辨别力下降,表明该层适合于层之间的粗略分类,而不是层内排名。沿阿贝奥库塔南和伊杰布-雷莫轴线的中央走廊,有 7 个地方政府行政区被列为高风险,6 个为中风险,7 个为低风险。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 分层层导出为具有特定于层的操作包的 GeoJSON,并集成到 IDS-Master 平台中,作为从空间 流行病学 到常规公共卫生 流行病学 的概念验证途径。该研究提供了一种在 LGA 层面完善风险评估的方法,可以改善有针对性的公共卫生干预措施。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果可以为地方提供更精确的监测和应对策略,增强有效分配资源的能力。这种方法可以作为具有类似流行病学挑战的其他地区的模型。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 研究结果表明,该模型在粗略分类方面表现良好,但在层内排名方面可能不可靠,这表明需要进一步细化和验证。证据是温和的,因为它依赖于空间分类数据而不是个案地理位置。
